audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting netstandard2.0 or net8.0 who need programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in Windows, Linux, or macOS environments.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files via Workbook constructors, then modify worksheets, cells, and formatting through the public API surface.
capabilities.title: Create and edit workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply fonts, borders, fills, alignment, and number formats using Style, Font, Borders, and FillPattern types, with StyleFlag for selective property updates.
capabilities.title: Format cells and styles

capabilities.text: Define validation rules with ValidationCollection and Validation, and apply conditional formatting via ConditionalFormattingCollection and FormatConditionCollection.
capabilities.title: Add data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Create Excel tables using ListObjectCollection and ListObject with totals aggregation, and generate charts via ChartCollection and Chart.
capabilities.title: Build structured tables and charts

capabilities.text: Export worksheets to PDF using SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions, with page geometry controlled by Worksheet.PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Protect workbook structure with WorkbookProtection and individual sheets with Worksheet.Protect() to restrict editing.
capabilities.title: Protect workbook and worksheet content

limitations.text: Load support is limited to XLSX files; legacy formats like XLS, ODS, and CSV are not loaded.
Save support is limited to XLSX and PDF; image and HTML export are not available.
The library does not parse, evaluate, or recalculate formulas; Cell.Formula stores formulas as strings only.
Pivot tables are not supported; only structured tables (ListObject) and charts are available.
No VBA or macro support; macro-enabled workbooks retain only non-macro content on round-trip.
No print execution; PageSetup configures print layout but does not send workbooks to a printer.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side generation and modification of Excel workbooks without installing Microsoft Excel or using COM interop.
Supports recovery from malformed Excel files via LoadOptions and LoadDiagnostics, allowing graceful handling of corrupted input.
Provides structured data features like validation rules, conditional formatting, and Excel tables for data integrity and presentation.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source, MIT-licensed .NET library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a new Workbook, add data to Cells, apply formatting via Style, and save to XLSX or PDF using SaveFormat.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbook
workflows.text: Load a workbook with LoadOptions configured for repair, inspect LoadDiagnostics for issues, and register IWarningCallback for diagnostics.

workflows.name: Apply validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Add Validation rules via ValidationCollection, define conditional formatting via ConditionalFormattingCollection, and highlight data based on cell values.

workflows.name: Export to PDF
workflows.text: Configure PageSetup for print layout, then call Workbook.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions to render the worksheet to PDF.
